meta.name: Zomato vs Swiggy · Google Play reviews
meta.source: Public Play Store reviews, compiled in github.com/tanishka-anand/tanishka-anand-zomato-swiggy-review-intelligence (from Kaggle saloni1712/zomato-and-swiggy-play-store-reviews)
caveats: Collection method upstream is not documented. It is probably an English-language scrape, since Hindi script appears in under 0.1% of reviews.

Swiggy's upstream file (Jan 2022 to Jul 2023) is 64% one-star against 43% for Zomato's, and the 26 weeks used here are 65% against 33%. That points to different sampling, so compare complaint rates within rating bands.
Reviews are a self-selected, negatively skewed sample of users, not a population estimate.
